name: Nottingham Trent University

settingEvidence.evidence: You’ll mainly be studying in the Newton building, at the centre of our vibrant City Campus.

fees.text: £10,050 per year for UK (home) students on full-time undergraduate courses starting in September 2027 (2027/28). NTU's fee table also lists £2,010 for a placement year and £1,507 for a study-abroad year in 2027/28. NTU says home fees are subject to government policy and may change in future years of study.

source.evidence: £10,050 per year

livingCosts.text: Rent in NTU accommodation (including bills and internet) is about £98.84–£230.16 a week (2026/27). NTU accommodation usually has 44-week contracts. NTU also suggests about £35–£50 a week for food and housekeeping.

source.evidence: Rent in NTU accommodation (including bills and internet): £98.84–£230.16 per week

openDays.text: Next undergraduate open days: Saturday 7 November 2026 and Saturday 5 December 2026. NTU says to choose your subject and course on its page so you book the open day for the campus where your course is taught.

source.evidence: Saturday 7 November 2026

contextual.summary: NTU automatically gives a lower contextual offer, typically up to two grades lower, if you meet any one of its criteria.
contextual.typicalReduction: Typically up to two grades lower than the standard entry criteria; on these courses the contextual offer is 104 UCAS Tariff points instead of 112.

criteria.detail: Currently studying at Nottingham College, Vision West Notts College, Bilborough College, Confetti, on an NTU college course, or at one of NTU's named key feeder schools or colleges (full list on the page), and progressing to a full-time foundation, integrated foundation or undergraduate degree at NTU.
East Midlands postcode: home postcode is within the East Midlands devolved authority covering Derbyshire, Nottinghamshire, Derby and Nottingham.
Low participation areas: from an area of low participation in higher education, according to the Office for Students' Participation of Local Areas data (POLAR 4, quintile 1 or 2).
Care experienced: spent time in local authority care, foster care, or any formal care setting.
Free School Meals: may have received Free School Meals during secondary education.
Estranged from parents: you have no contact or support from your family.
Elite athletes: applicants who show exceptional sporting potential.

contextual.rulesText: You are guaranteed a contextual offer if you meet any of the listed criteria. NTU receives this information directly from UCAS, so you do not need to apply separately; it is applied automatically. You should declare all relevant circumstances accurately on your UCAS application.

source.evidence: You are guaranteed a contextual offer if you meet any of the following criteria:

courses.notes: No required, preferred or excluded A-level subjects are listed; NTU asks for UCAS Tariff points only. NTU's entry guide (https://www.ntu.ac.uk/study-and-courses/undergraduate/applying-to-ntu/entry-requirements-and-offers) uses A-level Psychology and A-level Geography in its worked tariff examples, and says an Extended Project can count as one of the up to four qualifications. The page's typical offer range is 104-112 points: 112 is the standard offer and 104 the contextual offer. Economics (with Foundation Year) BSc (Hons) is listed as a separate course on NBS's undergraduate list (https://www.ntu.ac.uk/study-and-courses/academic-schools/nottingham-business-school/study-at-nbs/undergraduate-at-nbs).

notes: NTU's offers are in UCAS Tariff points (112 standard, 104 contextual, from up to four qualifications), not A-level grades. NTU's entry guide says an Extended Project can count as one of the four qualifications.
No 2028-entry pages yet (checked 2026-10-21): course pages show a September 2027 start, so 2027 entry is recorded for all courses.
None of these course pages names an admissions test (the pages say there are no additional requirements).
NTU's open days page also lists a Thursday 25 February 2027 online event for international students only.

All seven courses are taught at City Campus in Nottingham (the course pages say On-campus (City Campus)). Property Finance and Investment is run by the School of Architecture, Design and the Built Environment; the others are in Nottingham Business School.
notConfirmed: 2028 entry requirements not published yet; 2027 entry recorded for all courses

Year 12 programmes: no NTU summer school or lower-offer access programme for Year 12 students found on ntu.ac.uk (searched 2026-10-21); only the Business Experience Day taster was found. NTU's outreach booklet is titled for Nottingham and Nottinghamshire schools
